text: Traffic for trailers and semi-trailers is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailers and semi-trailers is temporarily prohibited on the km39-km60 section (**Nakerala Pass**) of the **Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri** secondary road (road of domestic importance) and on the **Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali** road.

The information is released by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Regional Development and Infrastructure of Georgia. According to the same source, movement for other types of vehicles is unrestricted.
